dialect.detail: Student exercise likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or similar PC-based compiler; uses LINE SEQUENTIAL, LINAGE clause, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE, and Windows-style file paths (C:\COBOL\)

purpose.domain_detail: Student COBOL course exercise (Kiara Moyer, dated 1/20/2018) for an Albia Soccer Club fundraiser soda sales report
purpose.summary: Reads a population/sales master file, validates each record (state codes and pop type), and produces two printed reports: a valid-data sales report and an error report for invalid records. Calculates deposit amounts by state and accumulates totals by soda type and team.

notable_features: LINAGE clause with FOOTING for page control on two output files
88-level condition names for state and pop-type validation (VALID-STATES, VALID-POP)
EVALUATE used for state-based deposit calculation and pop-type mapping
FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE for dynamic date heading
Separate valid and error output print files
Team totals accumulation (A through E teams) with winner determination
No COMP-3, no COPY statements, no CALL statements
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; procedure division is partially visible but the overall structure is clear. Program ID is CBLKLM04 but ERR-HEADINGS2 references 'COBKLM05', likely a copy-paste artifact from a related assignment. No COMP-3 usage despite numeric accumulators, consistent with student-level code.
